Protect from light. USP 31 (Cysteine Hydrochloride). White crystals or crystalline powder. Soluble in water, in alcohol, and in acetone. Profile Cysteine is a non-essential amino acid. Cysteine and cysteine hydrochloride are used as dietary supplements.
